summary: Iteration 30: Forensic byte-comparison of CTS Shoonya PlaceOrder vs official OAuth SDK NorenRestApiPy 0.0.37, plus fix verification & full regression. Build (typecheck + pnpm -r build) PASS. Payload harness 27/0, copy-execution 35/0, ALL 21 harnesses PASS (Zerodha, Fyers, Upstox, Shoonya, Manual, Instrument, Integrity). The only production file changed is apps/api/src/brokers/shoonya/shoonya.adapter.ts (placeOrder path only). Shoonya reads and all other brokers are byte-unchanged. The proven payload mismatch (missing algo_id, missing trgprc, form-urlencoded, appended &jKey) is fixed and CTS now byte-matches the official SDK on Content-Type, body shape (jData=<json>, no &jKey), and mandatory fields (algo_id present+null, trgprc always present).

forensic_evidence.material_equivalence: Both transmit Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8, body prefix jData=, NO &jKey, and jData JSON includes algo_id (null) + trgprc + prctyp=MKT. Remaining diffs are cosmetic: JSON whitespace, prc '0' vs '0.0', trgprc '0' vs 'None', remarks 'CTSCopy' vs null, extra Accept header on CTS side, and double slash in SDK URL (SDK bug). None can trigger ALGO_CHK — that error is literally 'ALGO_CHK' meaning algo_id absent; both now include it.

scope_verification.shoonya_post_helper_reads_unchanged: CONFIRMED — line 272-274 still builds body `jData=${JSON.stringify(jData)}&jKey=${accessToken}` and httpPost defaults reqContentType='application/x-www-form-urlencoded' (line 206). All READ paths (getProfile/getMargins/getHoldings/getOrders/PositionBook/TradeBook/Logout) unchanged.
scope_verification.placeOrder_new_transport: CONFIRMED — placeOrder builds `jData=${JSON.stringify(jData)}` (no &jKey), passes reqContentType='application/json; charset=utf-8', jData includes algo_id:null and trgprc unconditionally.
scope_verification.other_brokers_unchanged: CONFIRMED via git diff --name-only — no changes to zerodha/*, fyers/*, upstox/*, icici/*, follower-execution.service.ts, follower-order-translator.ts, broker-response-normalizer.ts, copy-trading/*, instrument-translation, execution history, position lifecycle, or retry logic.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and surgical: only shoonya.adapter.ts placeOrder path changed; httpPost gains an optional reqContentType param with backwards-compatible default. Excellent scope discipline.
SDK URL has a double-slash (`NorenWClientAPI//PlaceOrder`) — cosmetic quirk of the upstream SDK; CTS uses the clean single-slash form which the broker gateway accepts equivalently.

Remaining cosmetic diffs (JSON whitespace, prc '0' vs '0.0', trgprc '0' vs 'None') cannot produce ALGO_CHK. If Finvasia continues to reject after this fix, the cause is conclusively account-side (algo trading not enabled on FA12345), not a payload mismatch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 completed the forensic byte-comparison sprint. CTS Shoonya PlaceOrder outbound HTTP now byte-matches official NorenRestApiPy 0.0.37 OAuth SDK on all business-relevant fields (Content-Type application/json, body jData=<json> with NO &jKey, algo_id present as null, trgprc unconditional). All 21 backend harnesses PASS; only production file changed is apps/api/src/brokers/shoonya/shoonya.adapter.ts. Live-broker acceptance cannot be verified in-pod (no DB/Redis/live session). If ALGO_CHK still occurs live, it is a Finvasia account-side restriction, not a payload bug.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA: Official NorenRestApiPy SDK (NorenApi.py lines 250-254 injectOAuthHeader, 567-617 place_order) ALWAYS injects `algo_id` in the jData payload and uses Content-Type application/json with body `jData=<json>` (no &jKey — Bearer token in Authorization header handles auth). The broker error 'ALGO_CHK' is literally raised when algo_id is absent. CTS previously (a) omitted algo_id entirely, (b) omitted trgprc for non-SL orders, (c) sent Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded, (d) appended &jKey=<token> to the body. Reproduction: /tmp/cts_shoonya_capture.cjs prints the CTS outbound request; /tmp/sdk_shoonya_repro.py builds the SDK-equivalent request from installed SDK source at /tmp/noren/pkg/NorenRestApiPy/NorenApi.py. Fix: shoonya.adapter.ts placeOrder now injects algo_id:null + trgprc always, uses application/json, and drops &jKey. httpPost() gained an optional reqContentType arg (default form-urlencoded so all Shoonya READ endpoints remain byte-identical). Mitigation: If the broker still returns ALGO_CHK after this fix, the cause is account-side (algo trading not enabled on Finvasia UID FA12345); the CTS payload is now byte-equivalent to the official SDK.
